sources.observed_fact: huggingface_hub environment variables are read at import time; HF_HOME, HF_HUB_CACHE, HF_XET_CACHE, HF_ASSETS_CACHE, and timeout knobs are relevant to deterministic cache binding.
sources.design_effect: Keep cache-root exports before any Hub import and preserve the project-local PUBLIC_TRACE_CACHE_ROOT contract.

sources.observed_fact: Transformers offline use requires files downloaded/cached ahead of time; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 prevents Hub HTTP calls; local_files_only=True can load from a local directory.
sources.design_effect: Do not merge snapshot download/materialization with evidence capture; capture stays local-only and digest-bound.

sources.observed_fact: The target TinyLlama model.safetensors is Xet-backed, 2.2GB, and publishes SHA-256 6e6001da2106d4757498752a021df6c2bdc332c650aae4bae6b0c004dcf14933.
sources.design_effect: Treat repeated full hashing/download as expensive; the runner must cache/materialize once then bind capture to a digest receipt.

sources.observed_fact: ACM frames artifacts as digital objects such as software, scripts, input data, and generated data; reproducibility involves an independent group obtaining the same result using the author artifacts.
sources.design_effect: Prefer a small executable runner and receipts over more internal doctrine/registry surface.
